files.rationale: Both PRs make upsertWorkflow honor workflow.scriptName; kept PR A's version, which also uses scriptName ?? workerName but only upserts workflows owned by this worker (scriptName undefined or equal to workerName), so cross-script workflow bindings are not re-registered against another worker.
Both PRs add the identical optional scriptName prop to WorkflowProps (differing only by a blank line), so a single copy is kept in PR A's formatting.
